output.summary: A genus of flowering shrubs or small trees native mainly to South America, with a few species in Central America, Mexico, New Zealand and Tahiti. It is remembered for abundant hanging flowers whose colours range from white through red and purple to orange. Its small berries are edible, though flavour varies greatly among species.
output.edibilityNote: The small berries are edible; depending on species, they may taste pleasant, bland or leave a bad aftertaste.
